newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Bomb explosion wounds eight in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Bomb explosion wounds eight in Karachi.

text.p: At least eight people were wounded on Saturday in a bomb explosion in a house in the city of Karachi in southern Pakistan, police said.
Police said the explosion was caused by a home-made bomb in a house near Liaqat market in District East.
An ambulance worker said the wounded included one child, three women and four men. No other details were immediately available.
